cards.title: Two Identity Paths, Only One Is Production
items: auth_provider defaults to demo: identity comes from the X-Demo-Actor-Id header, which is active only when DEMO_MODE is true and APP_ENV is not production, and fails closed when the header is missing (backend/app/core/config.py:61, backend/app/core/security.py:10-18, 123-154).

Supabase is the production provider. The console reads its @supabase/ssr session cookie and sends Authorization: Bearer on every request (apps/console/src/lib/api.ts:11-27, apps/console/src/lib/supabase/client.ts:47-52).

The employee portal and the Android app set getToken: () => null, so they are never shown as Supabase-authenticated; they identify with the demo header only (apps/portal/src/lib/api.ts:52-54, apps/mobile/src/api.ts:58).

A verified token grants nothing by itself: the subject is joined to a pre-provisioned users.external_subject row, and memberships, roles and permissions are read from the database (backend/app/core/security.py:253-269, 339-349).
Every path on this timeline is reachable in the current source at revision a779782f; nothing is drawn dashed and no step is simulated or inferred.

cards.title: Token Verification Is Bounded And Fail-Closed
items: Only asymmetric algorithms on the configured allow-list (RS256, ES256 by default) are accepted, so alg: none and HMAC-signed tokens are refused before any key is considered (backend/app/core/security.py:358-378, backend/app/core/config.py:73-78).

iss, aud, exp, iat, nbf and sub are required and verified against the project issuer and audience with a 30s clock leeway; the token itself is never retained, only an allow-listed claim set (backend/app/core/security.py:46-48, 307-324, backend/app/core/config.py:63-78).

The project JWKS is fetched over HTTP and cached for 300s process-wide; an unknown kid refreshes it at most once, and a JWKS fetch or key-set failure is a 401 rather than a bypass (backend/app/core/security.py:157-231, 234-250).
When DEMO_MODE is off the demo router is not registered at all, so its paths answer 404 without disclosing that a disabled surface exists (backend/app/api/v1/router.py:33-54).

cards.title: Every Refusal Is A Real Path
items: 401 (UNAUTHENTICATED) covers an absent, expired, wrongly-issued or unverifiable token; 401 also covers a verified subject with no provisioned active user (backend/app/core/errors.py:76-79, backend/app/services/actor_service.py:44-49).

403 (FORBIDDEN) is returned for no active membership, for an organization the actor does not hold, and for a permission the actor lacks - the coarse gate in Actor.require is necessary but not sufficient, and resource scope is checked separately (backend/app/services/actor_service.py:61-65, 130-138, backend/app/core/security.py:87-100, backend/app/services/scope_service.py:43-51).

422 (VALIDATION_ERROR) covers a reversed date range and any filter id that is not part of the active organization; 404 (NOT_FOUND) covers an unknown route, and a hidden record is answered exactly like a missing one (backend/app/api/v1/routes/analytics.py:50-53, backend/app/services/analytics_service.py:69-90, backend/app/services/scope_service.py:103-142).

500 (INTERNAL_ERROR) is deliberately generic - no stack trace, SQL fragment or provider payload reaches a client - and the request's transaction is rolled back (backend/app/core/errors.py:223-233, backend/app/api/deps.py:85-98).

cards.title: Where The Audit Event Really Comes From
items: This analytics read writes nothing: there is no audit append on GET /api/v1/analytics/overview, so none is drawn (backend/app/api/v1/routes/analytics.py:77-85, backend/app/services/analytics_service.py:279-340).

The audit event belongs to the write path: POST /api/v1/expenses is called by the employee portal and the Android app, and create_draft_claim appends expense.draft_created through audit_for_actor on the same session (apps/portal/app/upload/page.tsx:91-99, backend/app/services/expense_workflow_service.py:23-119).
One transaction per request: get_session commits on a clean return and rolls back everything on any exception, audit event included (backend/app/api/deps.py:60-98).

A retried create replays the stored response and a reused key with a different body is refused with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; STALE_VERSION (409) belongs to the version-asserting submit and decision transitions, not to draft creation (backend/app/services/idempotency_service.py:1-17, 60-111, backend/app/services/expense_workflow_service.py:122-126, 166-167).

audit_events is append-only through the trg_audit_events_append_only trigger - a database guarantee, not cryptographic immutability and not WORM storage (backend/migrations/versions/0001_initial_schema.py:1843-1852).
